name: biof3-local
description: BioF3 本地桌面版 — AI 陪伴的全组学学习与实战平台
author: BioF3

scripts.prebuild: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/plugin-manager.js && node --check core/r-server/plugin-loader.js
scripts.build:site: echo '[build:site] no-op: desktop is a standalone repo, Vite SPA output already lands in frontend/dist/. This hook is kept as a placeholder for a future monorepo layout.'
scripts.build:all: npm run build:spa && npm run build:site
scripts.build:win: npm run prebuild && npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:mac: npm run prebuild && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish always
scripts.build:mac-arm64: npm run prebuild && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.build:mac-x64: npm run prebuild && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.release:mac:prepare: npm run check && npm run build:mac && node scripts/publish-macos-oss.mjs --prepare-only
scripts.harness:agent-evaluate: node --test core/test/agent-workflow.mjs test/agent-approval.test.mjs test/agent-workflow-phase6.test.mjs test/harness-workflow-fixtures.test.mjs test/mcp-tool-registry.test.mjs
scripts.harness:phase6: node --test test/plugin-sdk.test.mjs test/harness-manifest.test.mjs test/harness-tool-template.test.mjs test/harness-workflow-fixtures.test.mjs test/agent-workflow-phase6.test.mjs core/test/agent-workflow.mjs
scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/plugin-manager.js && node --check core/r-server/plugin-loader.js && node --check scripts/scaffold-harness-tool.mjs && npm run harness:check && npm run ui:audit:check
